run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 core government portals were swept via WebSearch across all jurisdictions: Commonwealth (AusTender), NSW (buy.nsw / NSW eTendering), VIC (Buying for Victoria), QLD (QTenders), WA (Tenders WA), SA (SA Tenders and Contracts), TAS (Tenders Tasmania), NT (QTOL) and ACT (Tenders ACT). Verifiable open opportunities with recognisable titles and September/October 2026 closing dates were captured for every jurisdiction. Tier 2 was sampled across local government (VendorPanel), universities (University of Sydney TenderLink) and government-owned water/port corporations. Tier 3 (private/corporate) was checked: SAP Business Network Discovery and mining-buyer portals (Rio Tinto Buy Local, BHP, Fortescue) were reviewed but current publicly-visible corporate RFx were login-gated or expired, so those portals are recorded in discovered_sources rather than fabricated as tenders. Direct WebFetch to government portal domains (tenders.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au, tenders.tas.gov.au, portal.tenderlink.com) was blocked by the network egress proxy, so tender detail was captured from search-result snippets at headline level; most entries therefore still need a deliverables/detail pass.
gaps: WebFetch to www.tenders.nsw.gov.au blocked by network egress proxy — NSW tender detail pages could not be opened; captured at headline level from search snippets.
WebFetch to www.tenders.vic.gov.au blocked by network egress proxy — Victorian tender detail pages could not be opened.
WebFetch to www.tenders.tas.gov.au blocked by network egress proxy — Tasmanian OpenForBids list could not be opened directly.
WebFetch to portal.tenderlink.com blocked by network egress proxy — University of Sydney and other TenderLink portal detail pages could not be opened; captured from search snippets.

SAP Business Network (Ariba) Discovery: open corporate RFx require a free supplier login to view full opportunity detail; no publicly-visible Australian opportunity could be confirmed this run without an authenticated session.

BHP / Fortescue supplier opportunities are behind registration walls; Rio Tinto Buy Local's only visible EOI (HVAC Maintenance, Wickham) had already closed (07-Jul-2026), so no current mining-buyer tender was captured.

Deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, values and contacts for all captured tenders still need a detail/document pass — recorded because portal detail pages were egress-blocked, not because they are unpublished.
Invitation-only corporate/management-consultancy RFPs are out of scope (never published) and were not fabricated.
